description: Sector registry — the single source of truth for what a sector is. A sector classifies a board, is set at board creation, and is locked afterward. It drives two things: (1) which capabilities the board exposes — 'capabilities' is an allow-list, and everything else in runners.json's capability registry is hidden on that board (hidden = registry complement of the allow-list); null means expose all capabilities, no restriction. (2) which context the board seeds at creation. 'team' distinguishes a shared client/team board from a single-user personal board. Add a sector by adding an entry here; seeding reads this registry rather than hardcoding any sector.

sectors.label: Personal Board
sectors.description: A single-user personal workspace with no client attached. Exposes every capability — it is the owner's own sandbox.

sectors.label: Software Development
sectors.description: A software engineering board. The deliverable is code: agents work inside the client repository, open pull requests, and run automated tests. Exposes every capability.

sectors.label: Manufacturing
sectors.description: Industrial operations — quality management, safety compliance, process documentation. The deliverable is a document, not code. Agents read client-supplied files, produce structured documents, and verify them against the client's standards. Read-only on source files.

sectors.label: Healthcare
sectors.description: Clinical and care operations — clinical protocols, care pathways, patient information, safety and governance documentation. The deliverable is a document, not code. Agents read client-supplied files, produce structured clinical documents, and verify them against the client's clinical document standard and safety criteria. Read-only on source files.
